# `FONT_MISSING`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | warning |
| Area | [Fonts (`FONT_`)](README.md#domain-font) |
| Reported by | `plugin` (forecast by `holotype doctor`) |

## What happened

A font is not available in Figma; the fallback was applied.

## What to do

Install the font for your Figma team, or map it in the **Fonts** screen; a re-sync restores the original.
